data.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause: _init_cycle_ledger (runner.py:409-452) does not implement SHA-change cycle reset. cycle_number retains old count after new commits. cycle_dispatcher.next_action has correct SHA-reset but its return is not propagated back to cycle_number. Secondary: CI workflow DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE env var overcounts by tallying finding headers across all commits. Fix: add SHA-reset to _init_cycle_ledger (requires passing reviewed_sha and moving git rev-parse earlier in flow).
